    Farkas's lemma over an ordered field #

    Ported from ExtensionClosedString.Mesh.Farkas in the extension-closed string formalization.

    A finite system b ≤ A x is either solvable, or there is y ≥ 0 with yᵀ A = 0 and yᵀ b > 0 (farkas). The proof is Fourier–Motzkin elimination of the last variable.
